about: PickleballRecs starter catalog. Every value was read on the linked maker page (or, where noted, Pickleball Central) on the checked date and approved by the owner on 2026-10-19. Blank = not published. Products sold in several shapes are one entry per shape. Model year = maker's wording/URL, otherwise the year the maker's shop listed the product; Franklin gives none, 2025 used with the owner's OK. Swing weight is on each maker's own scale. Columns: core = core thickness, balance = swing weight. Expansion (owner chose current + popular brands, 2026-10-20): 2024–2026 performance paddles from the brands above plus Vatic Pro, Gearbox, Proton, Bread & Butter, 11SIX24, Volair, Diadem, ProKennex, Holbrook and Ronbus; colour, signature, limited, demo and blemished listings merged or left out, beginner/budget models left out. Model year = the year the maker shop first listed the product. Expansion rows record shape and core thickness only where the product title states them; their other columns are blank because they were not recorded, not because they are unpublished. Batch 2 (owner asked for the brands r/Pickleball discusses most, 2026-10-20): Spartus, RPM, Luzz, Pakle, Pickleball Apes, FLiK, Neonic, Enhance, Helios and Pickle Poppers, plus Engage Axiom and the older but still popular Vatic Pro Prism (2023); same rules as the expansion. Batch 3 (2026-10-20): Friday and Honolulu from Pickleball Central pages, which give no model year, so 2026 (the current model year) is used with the owner OK, as for Franklin; Aireo from its own shop, with listing years. Since 2026-10-22 names and URLs carry no year (makers update paddles by name, not by year); "year" stays as the year the product was first listed, and ids keep the year they were first imported with (idsWithYear) so a re-import matches the existing rows. On 2026-10-23 the owner renamed Vatic Pro Prism to Vatic Pro Prism Flash (the base Prism model its reviews are about); its "id" keeps the original import id. Catalog adds on 2026-11-12 (3+ held first-hand reviews, owner standing OK): values from the maker page, a major retailer, or the web.archive.org copy of a maker page that is gone; year = the year stated, else the maker shop listing date or the earliest archived copy of the maker page. Second round on 2026-11-13: same rules; Juciao values come from its USA Pickleball approval detail pages (no maker shop could be read). The maker's "unMARKed 2026" is "MARK unMARKed" (year 2026) under the no-year rule; the older "unMARKed 2025" (formerly unMARKed Alpha) is a different paddle.
